{{Current events|year=2025|month=02|day=23|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli occupation of the West Bank]]
***[[2025 Israeli operation in the West Bank]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces]] deploy [[Armored Corps (Israel)|tanks]] into the [[West Bank]] for the first time since [[Second Intifada|2002]], declaring that the 40,000 [[Palestinians]] who fled [[Palestinian refugee camps|refugee camps]] in the region cannot [[Palestinian right of return|return]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-ceasefire-hostages-02-23-2025-1c2dc86afd2e05888d5d588f462e898b (AP)] [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/amid-growing-crackdown-israeli-tanks-enter-occupied-west-bank-for-the-first-time-since-2002 (PBS)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
****At least three [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|IS–Somalia]] fighters are killed in a joint [[Puntland Dervish Force|Puntland armed forces]]–[[U.S. Africa Command]] [[airstrike]] targeting IS militants hiding in the [[Cal Miskaad]] mountains of the [[Bari Region]] of [[Puntland]], [[Somalia]]. [https://horseedmedia.net/ciidamada-puntland-oo-raadadkii-duqaymaha-ugu-tegey-curaar-oo-ay-maanta-qabsadeen/401255/ (Horseed Media)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200376/somali_u_s_forces_conduct_airstrike_on_isis_hideout_in_puntland.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Australian frontier wars]]
**The [[University of Newcastle (Australia)|University of Newcastle]] publishes the final findings of its eight-year long attempt to record and map all major massacres of [[Indigenous Australians]] during the [[History of Australia (1788–1850)|colonisation of Australia]], finding that at least 10,000 were killed. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2025/feb/23/more-than-10000-first-nations-people-killed-in-australias-frontier-wars-final-massacre-map-shows-ntwnfb (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Israeli invasion of Lebanon (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
**[[Israel]] launches airstrikes in the [[Baalbek]] area in northeastern [[Lebanon]] and other areas in the south of the country. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-confirms-hitting-hezbollah-targets-in-fresh-lebanon-airstrikes/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war ]]
**The [[Sudanese Armed Forces|Sudanese Army]] recaptures [[El Geteina]], [[White Nile State]], [[Sudan]], after heavy fighting with the [[Rapid Support Forces]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article297827/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*Two toddlers are killed when a [[Land mines in Cambodia|buried land mine]] from a [[rocket-propelled grenade]] that was left from the [[Cambodian Civil War]] explodes in [[Svay Leu District]], [[Siem Reap province]], [[Cambodia]]. [https://www.shine.cn/news/world/2502231125/ (''Shanghai Daily'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[31st Screen Actors Guild Awards]]
**At the annual [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]], [[Timothée Chalamet]] wins [[Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Leading Role|Outstanding Leading Male Performance]] for his role as [[Bob Dylan]] in ''[[A Complete Unknown]]'', while [[Demi Moore]] wins [[Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Female Actor in a Leading Role|Outstanding Leading Female Performance]] for her role in ''[[The Substance]]''. [[Political thriller]] film ''[[Conclave (film)|Conclave]]'' wins [[Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Cast in a Motion Picture|Outstanding Ensemble Performance in a Motion Picture]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/02/24/g-s1-50426/conclave-triumphs-at-sag-awards-and-timothee-chalamet-wins-for-best-actor (NPR)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war]]
**Sudanese [[Government of Sudan|officials]] report that 58 people have been killed and 1,293 people have been affected by a [[cholera]] outbreak in [[Kosti, Sudan|Kosti]], [[White Nile State]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-cholera-outbreak-south-47ac3f39c10eb549785c7fc24608551a (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Ukraine–NATO relations]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says that he is "ready" to resign from the presidency in exchange for [[NATO]] accession as part of a potential peace agreement. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/23/europe/ukraine-zelensky-resign-nato-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-drones-anniversary-putin-trump-c8f73a98d071055be52a1b22b0785ecc (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[American Airlines]] Flight 292, flying from [[John F. Kennedy International Airport|New York]], [[United States]], to [[Indira Gandhi International Airport|New Delhi]], [[India]], is forced to divert to [[Rome Fiumicino Airport]] in [[Rome]], [[Italy]], due to an unspecified security concern later deemed to be non-credible. The flight was over the [[Caspian Sea]] near [[Turkmenistan]] when it diverted back towards [[Europe]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-us-india-flight-diversion-6738435dd6f4dd8d6249dc5d30452610 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 German federal election]] 
**[[Germans]] vote to elect the [[Bundestag]]. The opposition [[CDU/CSU]] wins a [[Plurality (voting)|plurality]], with 28.5% of the vote and 208 seats. The governing [[Social Democratic Party of Germany|Social Democratic Party]] finishes in third place with 16.4% and 120 seats, while the [[Far-right politics in Germany (1945–present)|far-right]] [[Alternative for Germany]] finishes in second place with 20.8% and 152 seats. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/02/23/europe/german-election-results-cdu-afd-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.dw.com/en/german-election-friedrich-merz-urges-independence-from-us/live-71700729 (DW)]
*[[Funeral of Hassan Nasrallah|Funeral of Hassan Nasrallah and Hashem Safieddine]]
**The joint funeral for [[Hezbollah]] leaders [[Hassan Nasrallah]] and [[Hashem Safieddine]] is held at the [[Camille Chamoun Sports City Stadium]] in [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://apnews.com/article/lebanon-israel-hezbollah-funeral-nasrallah-hashem-safieddine-5b698c1d403887135e35b20c4cb22413 (AP)]
*[[Protests against the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**Protests are held across [[Europe]] and [[Canada]] to mark the 3rd year anniversary of the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/thousands-rally-across-europe-canada-ahead-of-3rd-anniversary-of-russias-full-scale-invasion/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]
*The [[Holy See|Vatican]] announces that [[Pope Francis]] remains in critical condition, with a new diagnosis of mild [[kidney failure]], along with pre-existing conditions [[pneumonia]] and other unidentified [[respiratory disease]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/vatican-pope-pneumonia-06324d49846f26a24acec1da5fc74ab2 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*In [[cricket]] under the [[One Day International|ODI format]], [[Cricket in India|Indian]] cricketer [[Virat Kohli]] becomes the first player to reach the 51 [[century (cricket)|centuries]] and the fastest player to reach 14,000 [[run (cricket)|runs]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/icc-champions-trophy-2025/champions-trophy-2025-virat-kohli-leads-the-charge-as-india-demolish-pakistan-in-one-sided-affair/articleshow/118509034.cms (''Times of India'')] [https://apnews.com/article/kohli-champions-trophy-fastest-14000-runs-record-2b390d8ada093df935cca708df133563 (AP)]
